{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000068PK3R30HGT63","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group host "ECHO host" {
  node Service "QueryService" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/query-service.ts"
  node Executor "QueryExecutor" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/query/query-executor.ts"
  node Unread "UnindexedDocuments" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/unindexed-documents.ts"
  node Host "EchoHost" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/db-host/echo-host.ts"
  node Store "AutomergeHost" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-host/src/automerge/automerge-host.ts"
}
group index "index-core" right-of host {
  node Engine "IndexEngine" ref="packages/core/echo/index-core/src/index-engine.ts"
  node Tracker "IndexTracker" ref="packages/core/echo/index-core/src/index-tracker.ts"
}
edge Service -> Executor "execQuery"
edge Service -> Unread "unread per space"
edge Executor -> Store "read from disk"
edge Executor -> Engine "index rows"
edge Store -> Host "documentStored"
edge Host -> Unread "classify"
edge Host -> Engine "hasIndexed?"
edge Engine -> Tracker
edge Engine -> Service "pass done: re-run"
